description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” (orange bars)—across nine different datasets and evaluation metrics, displayed along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents “Score (%)”, ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10. In most benchmarks, the orange “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model outperforms the blue LLaMA-3-8B-it model, with particularly strong advantages on GSM-8K (both near 80%), HumanEval (orange ~65%, blue ~62%), TruthfulQA (orange ~60%, blue ~44%), ARC (orange ~64%, blue ~59%), and MBPP (both ~61%). On LC AlpacaEval2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, both models score lower, with “Ours” maintaining a consistent lead: LC AlpacaEval2 (orange ~32%, blue ~24%), MT-Bench (×5) (orange ~42%, blue ~40%), and Chat-Arena-Hard (orange ~30%, blue ~21%). The chart visually emphasizes the performance gains of the Iterative RLHF approach across diverse benchmarks, with the highest scores concentrated in the first few categories and a general decline toward the right, suggesting greater difficulty or different evaluation criteria in later benchmarks.
